question: It is a disease with dominant inheritance linked to the X chromosome:
analysis: Duchenne muscular dystrophy is a disease with X-linked recessive inheritance, not dominant. Fabry disease is also X-linked but recessive. Cystic fibrosis is an autosomal recessive disorder. Hypertrichosis is not linked to the X chromosome. Therefore, the disease with dominant inheritance linked to the X chromosome is Fabry disease.
